call_purpose: You wanted to find out why leads from your form were not receiving the autoresponder email.

resolved.text: We switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings, and you confirmed the email arrived after a test form submission.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it would be good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in Settings.
